summary: Master fixed income and bond strategies for pension funds. Learn LDI, ALM, and credit risk management to optimize long-term solvency. Enroll today.
lede: Fixed income and bond strategies for pension funds provide a structured approach to aligning debt investments with long-term retirement obligations. This course develops practical skills in liability matching, duration management, convexity adjustment, credit analysis, liquidity assessment, and risk-adjusted portfolio decisions. You will apply techniques including yield curve bootstrapping, Z-spread analysis, inflation-linked hedging, LDI framework design, bond ladder optimization, immunization, and performance attribution. Using real-world datasets and industry-standard valuation models, the training also introduces CDS applications, green bond certification, central bank policy effects on fixed income volatility, and digital-first reporting considerations.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for financial professionals who oversee or execute investment decisions within the pension and retirement fund sector.
modules: Fixed Income Foundations and ALM Integration
Yield Curve Analysis and Interest Rate Risk
Credit Risk Assessment and Corporate Bond Selection
ESG Integration and Sustainable Bond Strategies
Fixed Income Derivatives and Risk Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic financial mathematics and an understanding of the primary functions of a pension fund. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel for financial modeling is required. No prior experience with programming or advanced derivatives is necessary, as these will be covered at an operational level during the course.
